_comment: Golden set for the sample corpus in data/documents. Relevance is labelled at the document level (relevant_sources) so the fixture survives chunking changes. Items with expect_refusal have no answer in the corpus and test that the model declines instead of inventing one.

items.question: What is the notice period for a Head of Department?
items.reference_answer: 90 calendar days; notice must be given in writing to the line manager and the People team.

items.question: How many remote days per week are employees allowed?
items.reference_answer: Up to three days per week, recorded in the workforce system by 17:00 the preceding working day.

items.question: What is the annual leave entitlement and how much can be carried over?
items.reference_answer: 25 days plus 8 public holidays; at most 5 unused days carry into the next year and must be used before 31 March.

items.question: How much does the company match on pension contributions?
items.reference_answer: Up to 6 percent of base salary, vesting immediately.

items.question: Within how many days must an expense claim be submitted?
items.reference_answer: Within 30 days; claims older than 60 days are not reimbursed.

items.question: What is the probationary period and can it be extended?
items.reference_answer: Six months, extendable once by up to three months.

items.question: What is the minimum password length and how often must passwords be rotated?
items.reference_answer: At least 14 characters, rotated every 180 days, with no reuse of the previous 12 passwords.

items.question: How quickly must a security incident be reported and to whom?
items.reference_answer: Within 1 hour of discovery, to the Security team at security@acme.example.

items.question: When must the supervisory authority be notified of a personal data breach?
items.reference_answer: Within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach, where it is likely to result in a risk to data subjects.

items.question: What encryption standard is required for Confidential data at rest?
items.reference_answer: AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 or later in transit.

items.question: How long do access tokens last and how long are refresh tokens valid?
items.reference_answer: Access tokens expire after 3600 seconds; refresh tokens are valid for 30 days and are single use.

items.question: What are the API rate limits and what header tells a client when to retry?
items.reference_answer: 1000 requests per hour sustained and 50 per minute burst; HTTP 429 responses carry a Retry-After header.

items.question: What is the maximum page size for list endpoints?
items.reference_answer: 200 items; the default page size is 50.

items.question: How many times are failed webhook deliveries retried and what is the initial backoff?
items.reference_answer: 5 retries with exponential backoff starting at 30 seconds and doubling each attempt.

items.question: How long is an Idempotency-Key retained?
items.reference_answer: 24 hours; replaying the same key with a different body returns HTTP 409.

items.question: What is the capital of Portugal?
items.notes: Refusal probe: the corpus contains nothing about geography.

items.question: What is the company share price today?
items.notes: Refusal probe: live market data is outside the corpus and outside the model's knowledge window.
